questions.q: Menene Avana?
questions.a:
Avana yana bai wa masu samar da ruwan kuɗi damar amfani da matsayin AMM a matsayin jingina a Aave V4. Mai aro yana jingina LP token na Uniswap v2 ko matsayin Uniswap v3 ga LP Vault na Avana. Sannan mai aron yana aron GHO daga Avana Hub ta hanyar Borrow Spoke na Avana, yayin da ruwan kuɗin ke nan a cikin pool.

Avana yana aiki a Ethereum mainnet. Avana Hub da Borrow Spokes daidaitattun kwangilolin Aave V4 ne mallakar Aave DAO.

questions.q: Wane matsala Avana ke warwarewa?
questions.a:
Masu samar da ruwan kuɗi yawanci sai sun cire ruwan kuɗi kafin su iya aro a kan jarinsu. Don yin hakan, suna fita daga pool kuma suna rasa samun kuɗaɗe da kewayon da suka zaɓa.

Avana yana sa matsayin LP da ake tallafawa su zama masu amfani a matsayin jingina. Matsayin yana nan a cikin pool. LPOracle na Avana yana ƙimanta shi, kuma Aave V4 yana rubuta shi a matsayin vault token da ke daidai 1:1 da ruwan kuɗin da ke ƙasa. Amfanin ga LPs shi ne sassaucin jari, ba tabbacin riba mai kyau ba. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar asarar wucin gadi, haɗarin farashi, da haɗarin liquidation.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ta bambanta da kasuwar lamuni ta yau da kullum?
questions.a:
Kasuwannin ba da rance na yau da kullum yawanci suna ɗaukar jingina a matsayin ragowar token masu sauƙi, kamar ETH, BTC, stablecoins, ko wasu kadarorin ERC-20. An gina Avana ne don jinginar da ke canzawa a tsawon lokaci. Matsayin LP ya ƙunshi kadarori biyu kuma yana samun kuɗaɗe. Abin da ya ƙunsa yana canzawa yayin da farashi ke motsi, yana iya fita daga kewayonsa, kuma yana buƙatar takamaiman hanya don warware shi.

Saboda haka, Avana yana tsayar da haɗari bisa kowace kasuwa. Kowane pool da aka amince da shi, da kewayo inda ya dace, yana da nasa vault token, collateral factor, iyakoki, da yanayin sasantawa. Collateral factor yana farawa daga collateral factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens biyu na pool sannan a rage shi saboda haɗarin da ya keɓanta ga pool.

questions.q: Waɗanne AMMs ne Avana ke tallafawa?
questions.a:
Avana yana tallafa wa zaɓaɓɓun LP tokens na Uniswap v2 da matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum mainnet. Ga Uniswap v3, matsayi masu cikakken kewayo da kewayon da aka amince da su musamman kaɗai ake karɓa.

Ƙara Uniswap v4, Curve, Balancer, Aerodrome, wasu AMMs, ko wasu chains kamar Base yana buƙatar nasa bitar fasaha da haɗari da amincewar gudanarwar Aave. Ana amincewa da pools ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Avana yana cire pools na meme-token, pools marasa isasshen tarihin ruwan kuɗi ko ingantaccen farashi daga waje, da pools da za a iya hana cire ruwan kuɗi daga cikinsu.

questions.q: Shin Avana yana maye gurbin AMM inda kuɗin ruwa na yake?
questions.a:
A'a. AMM har yanzu yana kula da musaya (swaps), halin pool, motsin farashi, da samar da kuɗaɗe. Avana yana ƙara matakin jingina a kewayen matsayin LP da ake tallafawa.

Lokacin da kuka jingina matsayi da ya cancanta, LP Vault na Avana yana riƙe da shi, kuma Avana yana ƙirƙirar vault token da ya dace don Aave V4. Ruwan kuɗin yana nan a cikin pool na AMM kuma yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe muddin yana cikin kewayonsa.

questions.q: Ta yaya Avana ke aiki a babban mataki?
questions.a:
Avana yana aiki a matakai uku. Na farko, kuna jingina matsayin LP da ake tallafawa ga LP Vault. Na biyu, Risk Module na Avana yana duba pool, matakin kuɗi, kewayo, samuwar oracle, da iyakoki. Sannan Aave Adapter yana ƙirƙirar vault token da ya dace kuma yana samar da shi ga Borrow Spoke na Avana na wannan kasuwa. Na uku, kuna aron GHO daga Avana Hub har zuwa ƙarfin aronku.

Matsayin LP yana nan a cikin AMM. Kwangilolin Avana na kansa suna kula da riƙo, ƙimantawa, da sasantawa. Avana Hub da Borrow Spokes daidaitattun kwangilolin Aave V4 ne waɗanda ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO.

questions.q: Me ya sa Avana ke amfani da tsarin Hub-and-Spoke na Aave V4?
questions.a:
Avana yana amfani da Aave V4 saboda yana raba ruwan kuɗi na bai ɗaya da saitunan haɗari na musamman ga kowace kasuwa. Avana Hub yana riƙe da layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka wanda Aave DAO ya ware. Borrow Spokes da aka amince da su kaɗai ne za su iya cirewa daga gare shi.

Kowane Borrow Spoke yana shafar rukunin kasuwa guda da nasa sigogi da iyakoki: stable LP (wanda ake la'akari: USDC/USDT), correlated LP (wanda ake la'akari: wstETH/WETH), da blue-chip/stable LP (wanda ake la'akari: WETH/USDC). Har yanzu ana tantance waɗanda ake la'akari da su. Avana ba ya yin fork ko gyara lambar Aave V4. Dukkan lambar aiki da ta keɓanta ga Avana tana cikin kwangilolin Avana na kansa.

questions.q: Menene Zuƙowar Ara?
questions.a:
Borrow Spoke daidaitaccen Aave V4 Spoke ne mallakar Aave DAO. Yana karɓar vault tokens na Avana a matsayin jingina kuma yana bai wa masu aro damar cire GHO daga Avana Hub. Yana aiwatar da collateral factor, Collateral Risk, da sigogin liquidation na kasuwanninsa.

Avana yana amfani da Borrow Spokes daban-daban saboda ba dukkan matsayin LP ne ke da ɗabi'a iri ɗaya ba. Haɗin stablecoins biyu, haɗin kadarori masu tafiya tare kamar wstETH/WETH, da haɗin blue-chip/stable kamar WETH/USDC suna buƙatar collateral factors, iyakoki, da saitunan sasantawa daban-daban.

questions.q: Menene alamun Avana vault?
questions.a:
Vault tokens tokens ne na ERC-20 na jingina kawai waɗanda ke wakiltar matsayin LP da aka jingina a Aave V4. Kowane pool da aka amince da shi, da kewayo inda ya dace, yana da nasa vault token. Avana yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens 1:1 da ruwan kuɗin da ke ƙasa lokacin da kuka jingina matsayi kuma yana ƙone su lokacin cirewa ko sasantawa. Babu jadawalin fitarwa, babu fitar da tokens (emissions), kuma babu farashin musaya.

Vault tokens ba kadarorin mai amfani ba ne kuma ba su da kasuwa ta biyu. Suna matsawa ne kawai tsakanin Avana Hub, Borrow Spokes, Position Proxies, Aave Adapter, da LPVaultSwap. Kowane vault token da ke yawo yana da goyon bayan ruwan kuɗin da ake riƙewa a LP Vault.

questions.q: Menene manyan sassan tsarin Avana?
questions.a:
LP Vault yana riƙe da LP tokens da NFTs da aka jingina. Yana rubuta mai shi, pool, haɗin tokens, matakin kuɗi, kewayo, da halin kowane matsayi. Risk Module yana duba cancantar pool, jerin izini na matakin gwaji, iyakokin girman matsayi, da iyakokin fallasa. Collateralization Module yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens 1:1 da ruwan kuɗi. LPOracle yana ƙimanta vault tokens daga Chainlink kuma yana amfani da TWAP na pool a matsayin bincike na biyu.

Aave Adapter shi ne mashigar mai aro. Yana kula da ajiya, aro, biyan bashi, da cirewa ta keɓaɓɓen Position Proxy ga kowane mai aro. LPVaultSwap yana gudanar da liquidations da flash loans, kuma adaftocin sasantawa na AMM suna cire ruwan kuɗi da karɓar kuɗaɗe. Kwangilolin Avana masu iya haɓakawa suna bayan timelock da Avana Labs ba zai iya tsallakewa ba. Aave DAO yana riƙe da ayyukan dakatarwa da daskarewa.

questions.q: Me ke faruwa lokacin da na ajiye jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Lokacin da kuka jingina matsayin LP da ake tallafawa, Aave Adapter yana ajiye shi a cikin LP Vault. Sannan Risk Module yana duba pool, matakin kuɗi, kewayo, samuwar oracle, da iyakoki. A lokacin matakin gwaji, masu ajiya da ke cikin jerin izini kaɗai ne za su iya jingina, kuma kowace kasuwa tana da mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman girman matsayi.

Da zarar binciken ya yi nasara, Avana yana ƙirƙirar vault token da ya dace kuma yana samar da shi a matsayin jingina a kan Borrow Spoke ta Position Proxy ɗinku. Jinginarwa ba ta yin aro da kanta. Tana samar da ƙarfin aro da za ku iya amfani da shi muddin asusun yana cikin ƙoshin lafiya kuma akwai ruwan kuɗin GHO.

questions.q: Shin matsayin LP na zai ci gaba da aiki bayan ajiya?
questions.a:
Ee. Jinginarwa tana canza mai riƙe da shi, amma ba ta cire ruwan kuɗi daga pool ba. Pool yana ci gaba da sarrafa musaya, kuma matsayinku yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe. Matsayin Uniswap v3 yana daina samun kuɗaɗe yayin da yake a wajen kewayonsa.

Yayin da bashi ke buɗe, matakan da ke rage jingina, kamar cirewa, suna bi ta Aave Adapter. Ana ba da izinin su ne kawai idan asusun ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya bayan haka.

questions.q: Shin zan iya karɓar kuɗin LP yayin da nake aro?
questions.a:
Kuɗaɗe suna ci gaba da taruwa ga matsayinku yayin da yake cikin LP Vault. Lokacin da kuka cire, LP Vault yana sakin LP tokens ko NFT ɗinku tare da kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba.

Kuna iya cire gaba ɗaya da zarar an biya bashinku, ko ku cire wani ɓangare na matsayin idan asusunku ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya bayan haka.

questions.q: Shin kudaden LP suna cikin ƙimar jingina?
questions.a:
LPOracle yana ƙimanta ruwan kuɗin da ke cikin matsayinku. Yana lissafa adadin tokens daga lissafin ruwan kuɗi na pool kuma yana ƙimanta su a farashin Chainlink, ba tare da ragi ba. Ana sakin kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba tare da matsayin lokacin da kuka cire.

Collateral factor na kasuwar yana tsayar da iyakokin aro daban. Avana ba ya rage ƙimar oracle.

questions.q: Yaushe zan iya janye jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Kuna iya cire gaba ɗaya bayan an biya bashinku. Kuna iya kuma cire wani ɓangare na jinginarku idan asusun ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya bayan haka. Aave Adapter yana cirewa kuma yana ƙone vault tokens da suka dace, kuma LP Vault yana sakin LP tokens ko NFT ɗinku tare da kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba.

Biyan bashi da cirewa suna aiki ma ba tare da frontend na Avana ba, ta hanyar kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye. Ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire na son rai yayin da farashin oracle ya tsufa ko binciken TWAP ya gaza. Biyan bashi yana ci gaba a waɗannan yanayi.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ke ƙayyade farashin jinginar LP?
questions.a:
LPOracle yana ƙimanta kowane vault token daga lissafin ruwan kuɗi na pool a farashin Chainlink. Tsarin lissafin shi ne value = q0·P0 + q1·P1, inda q0 da q1 su ne adadin tokens da ke bayan vault token ɗaya. Ga matsayin Uniswap v3, adadin tokens yana fitowa daga ruwan kuɗi da kewayon matsayin a farashin ma'auni.

Oracle yana ba da rahoton ƙima ba tare da ragi ba. Collateral factor na kasuwar yana tsayar da iyakokin aro daban. Collateral factor yana farawa daga collateral factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens biyu na pool kuma ana rage shi da ma'aunin haɗarin pool.

questions.q: Ta yaya Avana ke rage haɗarin oracle da farashi?
questions.a:
Chainlink shi ne ma'aunin ƙimantawa. TWAP na pool binciken daidaito ne, ba matsakaici ko madadi ba. Idan TWAP ya fita daga iyakar da aka yarda, ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire masu ƙara haɗari. Biyan bashi da liquidation suna ci gaba a farashin Chainlink.

Idan feed na Chainlink ya tsufa, oracle yana amfani da farashi na ƙarshe mai inganci har zuwa iyakar tsufa. A wannan lokacin, ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire na son rai. Bayan iyakar tsufa, liquidations suna tsayawa har sai feed ya dawo ko gudanarwa ta amince da feed na ajiya. Biyan bashi yana ci gaba.

questions.q: Shin Avana yana rage darajar baka?
questions.a:
Avana ba ya rage ƙimar oracle kanta. Maimakon haka, collateral factor na kowace kasuwa yana la'akari da yawan ƙimar da za a iya dawo da ita a liquidation. Tsarin lissafin shi ne: LP collateral factor = collateral factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens biyu na pool × ma'aunin haɗarin pool.

Ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana nuna kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool, da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani. Gauntlet ya ba da shawarar farawa da ƙasa har zuwa 0.25× na factor mafi ƙanƙanta na ƙasa idan kadarar da aka aro ba ɗaya daga cikin tokens na pool ba ce, kamar GHO a kan WETH/USDC.

questions.q: Me ya sa ake kula da matsayin tsarin mai yawa na ruwa da kyau?
questions.a:
Matsayin tattaccen ruwan kuɗi suna canza fallasa da sauri yayin da farashi ke motsi. Matsayi na iya zama galibi kadara ɗaya, ko ya fita daga kewayonsa ya daina samun kuɗaɗe.

Avana yana karɓar matsayin Uniswap v3 masu cikakken kewayo ne kawai da kewayon da aka amince da su musamman, kowanne da nasa vault token. Oracle yana lissafa adadin tokens daga ruwan kuɗi da kewayon matsayin. Kowace kasuwa tana tsayar da nata ma'aunin haɗarin pool da yanayin sasantawa.

questions.q: Wadanne bayanan kasuwa ne Avana ke lura da su?
questions.a:
Risk Module na Avana yana duba fallasa a matakin pool, token na ƙasa, da mai ajiya, ciki har da iyaka kan kason ruwan kuɗin pool. Kowace kasuwa tana da nata ma'aunin haɗarin pool, yanayin sasantawa, tsawon lokacin TWAP, karkacewar farashi da aka yarda, da iyakar tsufan feed.

Avana Labs yana wallafa rahotannin amfani na mako-mako da rahotannin kuɗaɗen shiga na wata-wata. Rahotannin sun ƙunshi bashi da jingina bisa kasuwa, taruwar fallasa, rabon ma'aunin lafiya, da liquidations da suka yi nasara, suka gaza, da aka sake gwadawa. Sun kuma ƙunshi amfani da FirstLossReserve, mummunan bashi, matsalolin oracle, amfani da layin bashi, kuɗaɗe, da albarkatun asarar farko.

questions.q: Yaya aro ke aiki a Avana?
questions.a:
Bayan an jingina matsayinku kuma an samar da vault token ɗinsa a matsayin jingina, kuna aron GHO daga Avana Hub ta hanyar Borrow Spoke. Aave Adapter yana tabbatar da cewa binciken farashi ya yi nasara kuma asusunku ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya bayan sabon bashin.

Ana aika GHO zuwa walat ɗinku, kuma ana rubuta bashin a Aave V4. Riba tana taruwa a kan ribar tushe × (1 + ƙarin ribar haɗarinku), don haka ma'aunin lafiyarku na iya canzawa ko da jinginarku ba ta canza ba.

questions.q: Yaya ake ƙididdige ƙarfin aron kudi?
questions.a:
Ƙarfin aro = ƙimar matsayin LP × LP collateral factor. LP collateral factor shi ne collateral factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens biyu na pool wanda aka ninka da ma'aunin haɗarin pool. Ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana nuna kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool, da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani.

Ƙarfin aro kuma ya dogara ne da bashin da ake da shi, iyakokin fallasa, ruwan kuɗin GHO da ake da shi, da binciken oracle. Misali, matsayin WETH/USDC mai cikakken kewayo na $100,000 tare da collateral factor na ƙarshe na 35% yana da ƙarfin aro na GHO 35,000. Waɗannan alkaluman misali ne, ba sigogin kasuwa na gaske ba.

questions.q: Me ya sa ƙarfin aron ya ƙasa da ƙimar LP nawa?
questions.a:
Ƙarfin aro ya fi ƙimar LP ƙanƙanta saboda collateral factor yana barin tazara don motsin farashi, asarar wucin gadi (impermanent loss), canje-canjen kewayo, da kuɗaɗen liquidation. Oracle yana ba da rahoton cikakkiyar ƙima. Collateral factor yana tsayar da yawan wannan ƙimar da za ta iya tallafa wa bashi.

Ana amfani da ma'aunin haɗarin pool sau ɗaya kuma ana tsayar da shi bisa kowace kasuwa, don haka tazarar da ke tsakanin ƙimar LP da ƙarfin aro ta bambanta tsakanin kasuwanni.

questions.q: Waɗanne kadarorin zan iya aro?
questions.a:
Borrow Spokes suna ba da rancen GHO. Layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka daga Aave DAO ne ke ba Avana Hub kuɗi, kuma gudanarwa tana amincewa da kowane ƙari.

Ana aron wasu kadarori ta Lend Spoke na Avana, wanda gudanarwar Aave ke amincewa da shi daban.

questions.q: Shin zan iya aro akan matsayi da dama na LP a lokaci guda?
questions.a:
Ee. Matsayin da aka samar ga Borrow Spoke ɗaya suna tallafa wa asusu ɗaya, kuma ƙarin ribar haɗarinku matsakaicin ma'auni ne a tsakaninsu. Kowane matsayi har yanzu yana da nasa vault token, collateral factor, da iyakoki.

A lokacin matakin gwaji, kowane asusu yana da iyaka kan yawan matsayi. Dole ne dukkan asusun ya kasance sama da ma'aunin lafiya da ake buƙata.

questions.q: Yaya masu bayar da rance ke amfani da Avana?
questions.a:
Ba da rance yana gudana ta Lend Spoke na Avana, wanda ya bambanta da Borrow Spokes na GHO. Gudanarwar Aave tana amincewa da shi daban.

Lend Spoke yana bai wa masu ba da rance damar samar da kadarori kai tsaye ga Avana Hub kuma yana bai wa masu aro damar aron kadarori ban da GHO. Avana Hub yana kuma riƙe da layin bashi na GHO na Aave DAO.

questions.q: Daga ina ake samun amfanin mai kaya?
questions.a:
Ta hanyar Lend Spoke, masu ba da rance suna samun ribar da masu aro masu goyon bayan LP ke biya. Avana Labs yana riƙe kason protocol a kan ruwan kuɗin da masu ba da rance suka samar. Riba a kan layukan bashi na Aave DAO har yanzu tana zuwa ga DAO.

Masu aro suna biyan ribar tushe ta Avana Hub tare da ƙarin ribar haɗari bisa jinginarsu. Ana tsayar da ribar tushe daidai ko sama da ribar tushe ta Aave Core Hub. Gudanarwar Aave ce ke tsayar da ainihin sharuɗɗan masu ba da rance.

questions.q: Shin masu bayar da rance suna sarrafa jingina na LP da kansu?
questions.a:
A'a. Masu ba da rance suna samar da kadarori ga Avana Hub. Ba sa zaɓar kewayon LP ko kula da sasantawa. Borrow Spokes, LP Vault, da LPVaultSwap suna kula da ƙimanta jingina, binciken lafiya, da liquidation.

Gudanarwar Aave tana amincewa da Lend Spoke daban.

questions.q: Menene ke kare babban jarin mai bayar da aron kudi?
questions.a:
Fallasa kaɗai ta Aave DAO ita ce layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka, kuma kowane ƙari yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa. Matakan kariya sun haɗa da masu ajiya da ke cikin jerin izini a lokacin matakin gwaji, iyakoki ga kowace kasuwa, collateral factors da aka rage saboda haɗarin pool, farashin Chainlink tare da binciken TWAP, da liquidations da ke sasantawa a cikin ma'amala guda.

Idan liquidation ya cinye jingina alhali bashi ya rage, ana biyan asara bisa tsari: na farko daga keɓaɓɓen jarin asarar farko, sannan daga kuɗaɗen shiga da aka keɓe don biyan asara, sannan daga Avana Umbrella. Haɗarin kwangila mai wayo, oracle, da aiwatar da liquidation suna nan. Kwangilolin Avana suna cikin bitar tsaro ta cikin gida, kuma binciken tsaro na jama'a masu zaman kansu za su biyo baya.

questions.q: Mene ne ma'aunin lafiya?
questions.a:
Ma'aunin lafiya yana kwatanta ƙimar aro ta jinginarku (ƙima × collateral factor) da bashinku. Sama da 1, asusun yana cikin ƙoshin lafiya. Ƙasa da 1, ana iya yi masa liquidation.

A wani misali na bayani, aron GHO 25,000 a kan matsayin WETH/USDC na $100,000 tare da collateral factor na 35% yana bayar da ma'aunin lafiya na farko na 1.40. Manhajar tana taƙaita sabon aro a ma'aunin lafiya na buɗewa na 1.10.

questions.q: Me ke shafar lafiyata?
questions.a:
Ma'aunin lafiya yana canzawa lokacin da ƙimar jingina, bashi, ko sigogin kasuwa suka canza. Matsayin LP suna canza ƙima yayin da farashin tokens ke motsi, kuma matsayin Uniswap v3 suna kuma canza abin da suka ƙunsa a cikin kewayonsu. Riba tana ƙara bashi a tsawon lokaci.

Ƙara aro yana rage ma'aunin lafiyarku. Biyan bashi ko ƙara jingina da aka amince da ita yana ɗaga shi.

questions.q: Yaya ake gudanar da sulhun kudi a Avana?
questions.a:
Ana iya yi wa asusu liquidation idan ma'aunin lafiyarsa ya faɗi ƙasa da 1. A cikin ma'amala guda, LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar flash loan, yana biyan bashin, kuma yana sasanta jinginar LP da ke bayansa. Kowace kasuwa tana da yanayin sasantawa da aka amince da shi.

Sasantawa ta ɓangare tana shafar Uniswap v2 da zaɓaɓɓun kasuwannin Aerodrome ko Uniswap v3. Tana amfani da daidaitaccen liquidation na Aave V4. A al'ada, ruwan kuɗin da ake buƙata don dawo da lafiya kaɗai ake cirewa, kuma kuna riƙe sauran. Sasantawa ta cikakken matsayi tana shafar yawancin AMMs da ke amfani da NFTs. Tana sasanta dukkan matsayin kuma tana mayar wa mai aro duk wata rara bayan bashi, kuɗaɗe, da kashe-kashe.

questions.q: Wanene zai iya warware matsayi mai rashin lafiya?
questions.a:
Keepers da aka amince da su kaɗai ne za su iya kiran LPVaultSwap, wanda shi ne kwangila kaɗai da ke aiwatar da liquidations. Aƙalla masu aiki biyu ne ke gudanar da keepers: Avana Labs da aƙalla mai aiki ɗaya mai zaman kansa.

Buɗe liquidations ga masu liquidation na ɓangare na uku yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa.

questions.q: Wadanne kudade ne ake bi yayin rushewa?
questions.a:
A kasuwannin sasantawa ta ɓangare, kyautar liquidation ta Aave V4 tana biyan ladan keeper, kuɗaɗen aiwatarwa, da kuɗin liquidation na Avana mai iyaka. Saboda haka kuɗin ba ya ƙara wa mai aro kuɗi. Kuna riƙe ɓangaren matsayin da ba a cire ba.

A kasuwannin cikakken matsayi, ana cire ladan keeper, kuɗaɗen kashewa, da kuɗin Avana daga kuɗin sasantawa da aka samu, har zuwa iyakar kaso na bashi na kowace kasuwa. Ana mayar da duk wata rara ga mai aro.

questions.q: Ta yaya ake ƙara sabbin tafkunan LP?
questions.a:
Avana Labs yana gabatar da sabbin kasuwanni da sigogi, kuma wani keɓaɓɓen mai bitar haɗari yana bitar su. Ana wallafa kowane sabon pool na jingina don bita na makonni biyu kafin a amince da shigar da shi.

Pool yana buƙatar ingantaccen farashi daga waje, isasshen tarihin ruwan kuɗi, hanyar dawo da kuɗin liquidation a lokacin matsin lamba, da rashin wani hani kan cire ruwan kuɗi. Kowane AMM ban da Uniswap v2 da v3 yana buƙatar nasa bita da amincewar gudanarwar Aave.

questions.q: Shin sigogin haɗari na iya canzawa a tsawon lokaci?
questions.a:
Ee. Sigogin haɗari suna canzawa yayin da yanayin kasuwa ke canzawa. Pool na iya zama mai ƙarancin ruwan kuɗi, mai yawan sauyin farashi, mara tafiya tare sosai, ko mafi wahalar warwarewa fiye da lokacin da aka fara jera shi.

Sabuntawa na iya shafar collateral factors, iyakoki, pools da ake tallafawa, dakatarwa, sigogin liquidation, da yanayin sasantawa. Aave DAO ne ya mallaki Hub da Spokes kuma yana iya dakatarwa ko daskare kasuwanni ba tare da Avana Labs ba. Haɓakawa ga kwangilolin Avana suna bi ta timelock da Avana Labs ba zai iya tsallakewa ba, kuma DAO na iya soke su.

questions.q: A ina zan bi tattaunawar gudanarwa?
questions.a:
Ana tattauna Avana a dandalin gudanarwa na Aave (governance.aave.com) sannan a kai shi ga zaɓen Snapshot. Ƙaddamar da shi a Ethereum da samar da kuɗin GHO kowanne yana bi ta bitar dandalin ta gaba da nasa zaɓen Snapshot kafin AIPs.

Avana Labs kuma yana wallafa sabbin bayanai a X a https://twitter.com/avana_labs.

questions.q: Shin kudaden haɗin gwiwa na iya canzawa lokaci zuwa lokaci?
questions.a:
Avana Labs yana samun kuɗin frontend a kan manhajar hukuma da kuma kuɗin liquidation. Gudanarwar Aave ce ke tsayar da ainihin adadin kuma tana amincewa da duk wani canji daga baya. Kuna iya guje wa kuɗin frontend ta hanyar kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye.

Riba a kan layin bashi na GHO na Aave DAO tana zuwa ga DAO, ba ga Avana Labs ba.

questions.q: Zan iya aro GHO ta hanyar Avana?
questions.a:
Ee. GHO ce kaɗai kadarar da za a iya aro. Kuna aron ta daga Avana Hub, wanda ke riƙe da layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka da Aave DAO ya ware ta hanyar GHO Reserve.

Bashin GHO yana shafar ma'aunin lafiyarku kuma yana tara riba a ribar tushe ta Avana Hub tare da ƙarin ribar haɗarinku. Dukkan kuɗaɗen shiga na riba da suka danganci layin bashin suna zuwa ga Aave DAO.

questions.q: Shin GHO na iya zama wani ɓangare na jinginar LP?
questions.a:
A'a. Pools ɗin da ake la'akari da su su ne USDC/USDT, wstETH/WETH, da WETH/USDC, kuma har yanzu ana tantance su.

Ana iya ƙara pool da ke ɗauke da GHO daga baya ta hanyar bita da tsarin gudanarwa iri ɗaya da kowane sabon pool.

questions.q: Yaya zan biya bashin GHO?
questions.a:
Kuna iya biyan GHO tare da ribar da ta taru a kowane lokaci sai dai idan an dakatar da kasuwar. Kuna biya ta Aave Adapter ko ta hanyar kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye. Biyan bashi yana rage bashinku kuma yana ɗaga ma'aunin lafiyarku.

Bayan biyan bashi gaba ɗaya, kuna iya cire matsayin. Sannan LP Vault yana sakin LP tokens ko NFT ɗinku tare da kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba.

questions.q: Menene Avana Multiply?
questions.a:
Multiply tsari ne a cikin sandbox na jama'a na Avana a app.avana.cc. A cikin tsari guda, yana aro a kan jinginar LP kuma yana sake saka kuɗin da aka aro don ƙara fallasa. Sandbox yana amfani da kadarorin kwaikwayo kuma ba ya yin ma'amaloli onchain.

Multiply ba ɓangare ba ne na kasuwannin Aave V4 na Avana, waɗanda ke shafar aron GHO a kan matsayin Uniswap v2 da v3.

questions.q: Ta yaya Multiply ya bambanta da aron?
questions.a:
Aro yana ba ku kadarorin da za ku iya amfani da su kai tsaye muddin asusun yana cikin ƙoshin lafiya. Multiply yana amfani da ƙarfin aro mai goyon bayan LP a cikin dabarun da ake gudanarwa. Jarin da aka aro yana shiga cikin fallasa da aka amince da ita kuma ana bibiyarsa a matsayin matsayi ɗaya.

Multiply yana ƙara leverage. Leverage yana ƙara ingancin amfani da jari da yuwuwar riba, amma kuma yana ƙara asara idan farashi ya faɗi, haɗarin liquidation, da tasirin motsin farashi. Bin diddigin lafiyar asusu ya fi muhimmanci, ba ƙasa ba, idan aka maimaita aro a kan matsayi (loop).

questions.q: Shin zan ci gaba da riƙe LP na yayin amfani da Multiply?
questions.a:
Ee. Matsayin LP yana ci gaba da zama tushen jingina yayin da matsayin Multiply ke buɗe. Ba kwa buƙatar fita daga matsayin AMM don samar da fallasa mai leverage.

Matsayin LP har yanzu yana tallafa wa bashi, don haka ƙa'idojin jingina suna aiki, kuma ana iya yi masa liquidation idan asusun ya zama mara lafiya. Masu amfani suna sa ido kan ƙimar jingina, bashi, leverage, da rarar tsaron liquidation muddin loop ɗin yana buɗe.

questions.q: Menene ke iyakance mafi girman amfani da rance?
questions.a:
Mafi girman leverage ya dogara ne da ingancin jingina, ruwan kuɗin pool, sauyin farashi, amincewa da oracle, kadarar aro, iyakokin kasuwa, da zaton liquidation. Pools na stable ko masu tafiya tare sosai yawanci suna tallafa wa iyakokin leverage daban da pools masu sauyin farashi ko marasa zurfi.

Avana yana amfani da matakan sarrafa haɗari na musamman ga kowace kasuwa. Ana taƙaita leverage ne bisa ainihin jinginar LP da ke bayan matsayin, ba bisa ninkawa iri ɗaya da ake aiwatarwa ga kowane pool ba.

questions.q: Shin atomatik na iya taimakawa wajen sarrafa haɗarin matsayi?
questions.a:
Sandbox yana nuna samfoti na aiki da kai (automation) da ke sa ido kan lafiyar asusu kuma yana fara matakai kamar biyan bashi ko rage leverage kafin liquidation. Aiki da kai ba ɓangare ba ne na kasuwannin Aave V4 na Avana.

Aiki da kai kayan aikin sarrafa haɗari ne, ba tabbaci ba. Motsin kasuwa, yanayin ruwan kuɗi, jinkirin ma'amala, sabuntawar oracle, da samuwar hanya na iya shafar aiwatarwa har yanzu.

questions.q: Shin jinginar LP na iya tallafawa irin haɗarin perps?
questions.a:
A'a. Avana yana shafar aron GHO a kan matsayin Uniswap v2 da v3 da aka amince da su a Ethereum.

Kuna yanke shawarar yadda za ku yi amfani da GHO da kuka aro, amma Avana ba ya tura bashi mai goyon bayan LP zuwa perps ko wasu dabaru.

questions.q: Me masu amfani ke sa ido a kai bayan buɗe matsayi?
questions.a:
Masu aro suna sa ido kan ma'aunin lafiya, bashi, ƙimar jingina, ƙimar ribar aro, halin kewayon Uniswap v3, da nisan da ke tsakaninsu da liquidation. A cikin tsarin Multiply na sandbox, suna kuma ganin matakin leverage da kayan sarrafa warwarewa.

Manhajar Avana tana nuna waɗannan ƙimomin. Kuna iya ganin lokacin da matsayi ke cikin ƙoshin lafiya, lokacin da yake buƙatar kulawa, da lokacin da yake ƙara kusantar liquidation.
